title: Figure 11: QED rocket design by Dr. Robert Bussard and EMC2
description: Cutaway rocket schematic with a payload nose cone, a yellow LH2 propellant tank, an ion source (D + He-3 or B-11), a Farnsworth-Hirsch fusor, an electron beam generator and a Laval nozzle, connected by labelled lines. Captioned "Figure 11. QED Rocket Design by Dr. Robert Bussard and EMC2." The text describes the fusor as inertial electrostatic confinement and lists other fusion propulsion efforts by ESA and JPL/Rocketdyne/Rockwell.
